title: cornus alba f. gouchaultii
intro: Cornus alba f. gouchaultii, commonly known as Red-veined Dogwood or Gouchault's Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fever, and pain due to its antiseptic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cornus alba f. gouchaultii include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
